summary.note_on_language: All 6 PDFs and all 7 YouTube videos observed are English-language (titles/text). No genuinely Hindi-source material was newly ingested in this validation -- Hindi/Hinglish testing against these NEW sources is necessarily query-language-only (Hindi/Hinglish query against English source), not query+source cross-script. Genuine Hindi-source cross-script retrieval remains covered only by the pre-existing, already-validated Phase 2-4E-F1 75-entry benchmark.
summary.workspace_content_note: Because 5 of the 7 YouTube videos' real subjects did not match the workspace they were assigned to before ingestion (an expected consequence of the task's own 'do not guess from the URL' rule), 3 of the 5 test workspaces ended up containing more than one real subject: Data Structures workspace = Data Structures (PDF) + Computer Networks (video) + Trigonometry (video); Computer Networks workspace = Computer Networks (PDF) + Machine Learning (2 videos). This is treated as a genuine, unplanned but valuable contamination/precision test case, not a setup error to be corrected.
